trajectory.title: How this answer was built
trajectory.searchedOne: We searched the {pillar} pillar — a collection of research that faculty stewards approved in advance.
trajectory.searchedMany: We searched these pillars — collections of research that faculty stewards approved in advance: {pillars}.
trajectory.foundSources: {count} approved source(s) matched your question closely enough to build this answer:
trajectory.foundNone: No approved source matched your question closely enough. Rather than guess, we told you what we don't yet cover.
trajectory.foundFallback: No approved source matched closely enough, so this answer draws on wider Stanford Lifestyle Medicine research and is labeled that way.
trajectory.checkApproved: Every source used was approved by a faculty steward before the answer could use it.
trajectory.checkCoveragePassed: Coverage check passed — the research matched your question closely enough to answer.
trajectory.checkCoverageNotPassed: Coverage check not passed — so we said so instead of answering without support.
trajectory.checkCitationPassed: Citation check passed — the study cited in the answer matches a source on this list.
trajectory.checkCitationFailed: Citation check couldn't automatically confirm the cited study against the approved list.
trajectory.foundSuppressed: Approved sources supported this answer, but our automatic citation check couldn't confirm the exact match, so the list isn't shown here.
